name: Tai-Ivi
source:
Tai-Ivi takes pleasure in torture—specifically, in instilling his victims’ deepest fears. He falls into hysteria when his actions fail. Tai-Ivi is a typical villain who delights in mocking others’ failures and suffering. He harbors a particular hatred toward the Om’verai and the Annors (Ronna).

Tai-Ivi emerged from Beexen’s heart as the personification of her fears. He feeds on the fear of others—often fatally for his victims. He possesses the ability to create illusions and alter his voice. By the beginning of the game’s events, he lures his prey into traps set in the cemetery near the High Hills.
